full_page.content:
1946, October
RETREAT - Wednesday - I Con.
a) Physical - b) spiritual
II c.
Trifles - mortification continued .... Michaelangelo answers cri- ticism of trifles: "Trifles make perfection. But perfection is never a trifle." Ah trifles make to border on divine.
III c.
Tepidity .... "Would that thou wert cold or hot , but because Thou art neither cold or hot, I will begin to vomit thee out of my mouth."
IV C.
Repentence - Prodigal.
I will Arise and go to My Father and say to him:
V Piety. ....
VI Spiritual Reading
VII Silence
END OF RETREAT Oct 13 - 18, 1946
